subject: Renewal: private VPC + standby cluster expansion — term anchoring & credits
content:
From: Dana Schultz <dana@oakridge.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Garza <tom.garza@oakridge.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + standby cluster request (Oakridge)

Hi Priyom —

Quick summary from our side as we prep for the renewal: the team wants to expand our private VPC footprint to add a standby cluster in us-west alongside our existing primary cluster. We expect a 30% spike in peak inference during Q1, and we want the standby to be pre-provisioned for fast cutover.

Two asks we hope you can help with:
- Term anchoring: can Redwood offer a 24-month term with a price freeze for the first 12 months (we're trying to avoid repricing mid-project)?
- Renewal credit: we had a one-time usage overrun in Sept while testing — can that be folded into credits to offset the new standby provisioning cost?

We can share a PO once terms are agreed. Would like to land this before Nov 10 if possible.

Thanks,
Dana
Director of Infrastructure
Oakridge AI

---
From: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
To: Dana Schultz <dana@oakridge.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + standby cluster request (Oakridge)

Dana —

Thanks for the clear ask. High-level confirmation: we can provision a hot-standby cluster in us-west with pre-seeded images and KV cache warmers to minimize cutover time, and we can propose a 24-month renewal with a 12-month price anchor. I'll outline a short mutual action plan below and loop in engineering/solutions for sizing.

Initial MAP (subject to final SOW / PO):
1) Proposed term: 24 months; price anchor for months 0–12 (no model/infra surcharge).
2) Standby cluster: 2x A40-equivalent nodes (we'll run a quick perf check); autoscale burst for sustained QPS spikes.
3) Credit request: we can apply a one-time usage credit equal to the Sept overrun up to $12k, applied against the first renewal invoice.
4) Delivery timeline: pre-provision + smoke tests within 10 business days of signed SOW/PO.
5) Ops: two runbooks (cutover and rollback); Marissa will own validation tests.

Can you confirm you have procurement signoff for a 24-month term and whether the PO will reference an SOW? If yes, I'll generate an amendment and DocuSign link.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment references: SOW template will be attached after internal sizing.

---
From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Renewal + standby cluster request (Oakridge) — sizing + pricing

PRIYOM / MARISSA —

Looping you both for quick validation. Notes from pricing side: standby cluster (2x A40 equivalent) at list rate is $17,500/mo, with reserved commit credits we can offer a 15% uplift discount on cluster capacity for a 24-month locked term. We should also consider an ops onboarding fee ($3,500 one-time) for runbook production and smoke test days.

Options to present:
A) 24-month term, price anchor months 0–12, 15% reserved discount on standby nodes, $12k one-time credit applied to invoice 1, ops fee waived if PO signed before Nov 12.
B) 12-month term + immediate top-up (higher monthly rate, no price anchor) — fall back if procurement won't commit.

Marissa — can you confirm the 'pre-seed' work we need (image sync, KV warming) and estimate smoke test hours? Karthik — check if any regional capacity constraints for us-west the week of Nov 16.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Senior Renewal Manager | Redwood Inference

---
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + standby cluster request (Oakridge) — sizing + pricing

Quick answers:
- Pre-seed work: image sync + KV snapshot + scripted cache warmers. Estimated hands-on time: 6 hours engineering + 4 hours validation (smoke), total 10 hours.
- Ops doc/runbook: 6 hours for initial runbook draft, 2 hours review with Oakridge.
- ETA: if PO hits by Nov 10 we can schedule provisioning week of Nov 16; no current capacity holds in us-west but we should reserve the node allocation this week to guarantee the window.

I'll prepare a succinct SOW addendum (task list, acceptance criteria, test plan) and attach an XLS with the node pricing breakdown. Recommend offering option A from Kimberly but mark the ops fee as waived if they sign by Nov 12 to accelerate approval.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW-standby-clusters-attachment.xlsx (node pricing + tasks)

---
From: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
To: Dana Schultz <dana@oakridge.ai>, Tom Garza <tom.garza@oakridge.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + standby cluster request (Oakridge) — proposal & DocuSign

Dana / Tom —

Appreciate the quick coordination. Per internal review, here's the formal proposal we can send for signature today:

- Term: 24 months; price anchor for months 0–12 (no infra surcharge)
- Standby cluster: 2x A40-equivalent nodes in us-west, pre-provisioned and warm (see SOW for details)
- Pricing: standby cluster $14,875/mo (15% reserved discount)
- One-time items: ops onboarding fee $3,500 (waived if PO signed before 2026-11-12)
- Credit: $12,000 one-time credit applied to invoice 1 to offset Sept overrun
- Delivery: provisioning + smoke tests within 10 business days of signed SOW/PO

Next steps:
1) I will upload the SOW addendum and generate a DocuSign amendment now.
2) Please send the PO referencing DEAL-OR-2026-1106 or sign the DocuSign.
3) Once signed we will reserve capacity and kick off provisioning with Marissa.

Attached: Oakridge_PO_20261101.pdf (placeholder PO received via procurement) and SOW-standby-clusters-attachment.xlsx.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/preview/0A12B-standby-amend
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/OR-52419/DEAL-OR-2026-1106

Let me know if you want to move faster — we can temporarily reserve nodes this week pending PO.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Priyom —

Thanks, we got the PO attached and procurement is ready to route the DocuSign. We will sign the amendment today and reference the PO number. Confirmed: we want the ops fee waived and we accept the 24-month anchor with the credit applied as outlined.

Tom

Oakridge AI
